_comment: The NEUTRAL-PROMPT arm of §11 D203, beside aicheck30_slm2_base.json which is the shipped-prompt arm of the same 30 items. Model: Ollama tag slm2-base = stock Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 Q4_K_M from rishibrucelee/gaply-slm-models. THIS IS THE BASE, NOT THE ADAPTER: SLM-2's LoRA is unmeasured on this task (its run stopped at 10 of 30, see aicheck30_slm2_tuned_partial.json). Identical product path to the shipped arm -- same system prompt, think:false, temperature 0, num_ctx 16384, keep_alive 0, and the same 3072-token cap. The envelope DERIVES from the shipped gaply_core::ai_detect::classify_payload and overrides exactly two fields, verified by diffing the payloads before the run: (1) `instruction` no longer asserts the passage was flagged, (2) `output_schema.category` gains `human`. task, passage, required and the strength enum are identical. RESULT: HUMAN called machine falls 9/10 -> 1/10, but `human` is applied to 8/10 GENERATED and 7/10 PARAPHRASED items, and generated-vs-paraphrased falls 9/20 -> 4/20 against a 10/20 no-skill line. The verdict tracks the prompt, not the text. NEITHER prompt is shipped: the lane is declined (§11 D203).
